purpose: SSOT registry of the binaries a release deployment installs. Before this file existed the deployed set was a literal list inside the deploy CLI while the Makefile built a different set: the Makefile built and installed cynic, cynic-node and cynic-kernel, and the deploy executor installed only the first two. A release that declares one set and ships another is a silent divergence. Every site that names a deployable binary reads this file.

binaries.name: cynic
binaries.role: operator entry point: the CLI every surface is invoked through
